name: Triumph Scrambler 900 / 1200
engine: 865 cc air/oil-cooled twin (2006-2016), or 900 or 1200 cc liquid-cooled twin (2017-on)
intro: Triumph's scrambler line. Early bikes share the air-cooled Bonneville engine, later ones the liquid-cooled 900 and 1200.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2019-2020 Street Scramblers are in recall 20V472 (misrouted harness). 2022 Street Scramblers and 2023-2024 Scrambler 900s are in recalls 24V785 and 26V078 (alternator wiring).

G: 2006-2007 bikes have carbs. Later ones are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.
H: 2006-2016 bikes are air/oil-cooled and have no coolant to change.

recalls.what: Wiring harness may be misrouted and get damaged against the headstock.

recalls.years: 2022 Street models, 2022-2024 Bonnevilles, 2023-2024 Scrambler 900 and Speed Twin 900 (some)
recalls.what: Alternator wiring may short and overheat.

recalls.years: 2022 Street models, 2022-2024 Bonnevilles, 2023-2024 Scrambler 900 and Speed Twin 900 (some)
recalls.what: Alternator or regulator problem on the same range of bikes.
